name_zh: 港岛东：杏花邨·柴湾·筲箕湾·鲤鱼门
name_en: Eastern HK Island: Heng Fa Chuen / Chai Wan / Shau Kei Wan / Lei Yue Mun
blurb_zh: 2018 年山竹风暴潮淹没杏花邨停车场、鲤鱼门三家村；2023 年黑雨筲箕湾、柴湾严重水浸。
blurb_en: Mangkhut (2018) storm surge flooded Heng Fa Chuen car parks and Lei Yue Mun; the Sept 2023 rainstorm inundated Shau Kei Wan and Chai Wan.

name_en: Tseung Kwan O South / LOHAS Park
blurb_zh: 山竹期间将军澳南海滨长廊与地下停车场被海水淹没。
blurb_en: During Mangkhut sea water poured over the TKO South promenade into basement car parks.

blurb_zh: 1962 年温黛吐露港风暴潮重创沙田；2018 年山竹城门河单车径、曾大屋水浸。
blurb_en: Wanda (1962) devastated Sha Tin via a Tolo Harbour surge; Mangkhut flooded the Shing Mun River cycle track and Tsang Tai Uk.

blurb_zh: 大埔滘验潮站录得 1962 年 5.03 米、2018 年 4.71 米（海图基准面）的历史最高潮位。
blurb_en: Tai Po Kau gauge recorded 5.03 m CD (1962) and 4.71 m CD (2018), the highest in Hong Kong.

blurb_zh: 2023 年 9 月 7 日黑雨：黄大仙港铁站及商场、龙翔道被洪水冲入。
blurb_en: 7 Sept 2023 black rainstorm: floodwater poured into Wong Tai Sin MTR station, Temple Mall and Lung Cheung Road.

name_zh: 维港核心：中环·湾仔·尖沙咀
name_en: Victoria Harbour core: Central / Wan Chai / Tsim Sha Tsui
blurb_zh: 香港经济心脏；历史事件未大规模受淹，但千年一遇超强台风「天枢」情景下填海区面临考验。
blurb_en: The economic heart of Hong Kong; spared in past events, but reclaimed land is tested in the fictional 1-in-1000-year Super Typhoon Dubhe.

blurb_zh: 天鸽（2017）与山竹（2018）两度淹没大澳棚屋区，水深逾一米。
blurb_en: Hato (2017) and Mangkhut (2018) both flooded the Tai O stilt-house village by more than a metre.

blurb_zh: 50 米网格的全港粗略模拟，仅模拟风暴潮推进（不含降雨，50 m 网格无法可靠表达地表汇流）。
blurb_en: Coarse 50 m territory-wide run showing the storm tide only (rainfall disabled: 50 m cells cannot resolve overland flow).
